title: Descending Median
prompt:
**Description:** Given n integers, print them sorted in **descending**
order, then print the median. For even n, the median is the lower of the
two middle elements in the sorted-ascending order.

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 10^5). Line 2: n integers (|a_i| <= 10^9).
**Output:** Line 1: n sorted values descending, space-separated, no
trailing space. Line 2: the median.

**Example:** `4` / `3 1 4 2` -> line 1 `4 3 2 1`, line 2 `2`.

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: Descending sort; lower middle of 1 2 3 4 is 2.

tests.name: odd count
single
tests.hint: The element is its own median.

tests.name: all equal
tests.hint: Median of equal values is that value.
